lines.learner: 새해 다짐을 적어요. 행동을 바꾸고 싶어요.
lines.en: I'm writing my New Year's resolutions. I want to change my behavior.
lines.roman: saehae dajimeul jeogeoyo. haengdongeul bakkugo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. You've been late a lot lately, right?
lines.en: Yes. Second, I am careful with my words.
My attitude is sometimes not proper.

lines.beaver_en: I see. What's your next resolution?
lines.en: Third, I make a little effort every day.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of effort will you make?
lines.en: I build my abilities through exercise and study.

lines.learner: 네, 자신이 있어요. 나는 할 수 있다!
lines.en: Yes, I'm confident. I can do it!
lines.roman: ne, jasini isseoyo. naneun hal su itda!

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a last resolution?
lines.en: Fourth, actions are more important than words.

lines.beaver_en: Nice words. Where will you put it up?
lines.learner: 책상 앞에 붙여요. 매일 볼 거예요.
lines.en: I'll put it up by my desk. I'll see it every day.
lines.roman: chaeksang ape buchyeoyo. maeil bol geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'm rooting for you. Stick to it!
